menuPrompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create the FINAL PhotosYNC menu design board for an implementation specification, consolidating these accepted references without adding features. This is a native macOS MENU-BAR POPOVER, not an independent window. Reference1 is the latest accepted segmented-progress layout. Reference2 is the earlier native library-analysis visual language.
Canvas2560x1440. FOUR equally320-logical-point-wide menu popovers, aligned top, separated with enough gutter, natural heights, neutral warm-grey board backdrop and subtle native shadows. NO titlebar or traffic lights. Board title "PhotosYNC · 菜单定稿", subtitle "主蓝色已导入 · 深灰已跳过 · 浅灰未完成". Scene captions: "正在同步", "悬停详情", "正在分析图库", "等待恢复". Pixel-crisp native PingFang Chinese,13pt semibold headings,12pt body,11pt secondary captions, small SF outline icons, one consistent compact macOS style. Do not use web cards or large decorative graphics.
FIRST menu, running:
status "正在同步" small primary-blue circular sync glyph; caption "已处理 150 / 已发现 200" with circled-i.
Thin6pt horizontal STACKED determinate rail: exactly60%PRIMARY BLUE(imported120),15%DARK GRAY(skipped30),25%LIGHT GRAY(incomplete50). No floating activity capsule, no percentage text. Under rail small text legend blue-dot"已导入", darkgray-dot"已跳过", lightgray-dot"未完成".
Divider, exactlyTWO source rows. Each row has exactlyTWO text lines: line1 has grey caption prefix"…/2026/" followed on SAME BASELINE by dark basename"年度照片与视频原片"; line2"正在导入照片". Second row grey"…/2025/" followed by same dark basename, line2"正在扫描来源目录". Tiny outline folder icon, thin separators. Never separate folder name and parent path into different rows; leading ellipsis only. Fullpath remains hover behavior.
Footer fixed: "立即扫描" DISABLED GREY and "暂停同步" enabled neutral on one line. Lower quiet line "设置" with NO ellipsis, "退出 PhotosYNC".
SECOND menu identical but with one actual native hover popover anchored to circled-i, pointer hovering. Popover must not overlap other scene. Show readable details:
heading"已发现的文件"; aligned rows"已导入 120","已跳过 30","待处理 49","提交中 / 待确认 1","待重试 0"; divider; heading"本次扫描";"检查候选 86","新增导入 24"; footnote"统计当前启用来源的记录，包含此前扫描。总量随新文件发现而增加。" This is the only place historical/per-round detailed rows are visible. Tiny outside annotation"悬停、点击或键盘均可查看".
THIRD menu in DARK MODE for library-analysis state. Status"正在分析图库" with circular sync glyph, circled-i. SINGLE PRIMARY BLUE native determinate progress bar42.68%, caption"已分析 42680 / 100000 张". Explanation"完成图库分析后开始导入。部分照片可能需要从 iCloud 下载。". NO second synchronization bar while analysis is the foreground phase, no persistent cumulative counters; details remain under circled-i. Divider then one TWO-LINE path row grey"…/旅行照片/" inline light/primary"2026"; second"等待图库分析完成后继续". Footer"立即扫描" enabled blue (this synthetic state activeWork=false),"暂停同步" neutral enabled; lower"设置","退出 PhotosYNC". Original known library total must not be mixed with source-discovered total.
FOURTH waiting light menu: status"等待恢复" amber-neutral clock; human visible explanation"网络共享未挂载，挂载后会自动继续。" Then"已处理 150 / 已发现 200", same60/15/25blue/darkgrey/lightgrey segmented bar and legend. Source2026 row same2-linepath, status"来源目录不可用，正在等待恢复。"; source2025 status"正在导入照片". Disabled scan, enabled pause, footer same. Critical warning stays directly visible regardless of progress.
All controls are existing actions, no Retry/thresholds/extra navigation. Even a full bar doesn't change the actual runtime headline; percentage is relative only to known persisted source records. Keep four panel widths consistent and avoid excess vertical blank space. Exact current date2026-10-13Asia/Shanghai if any dates appear. This board is a concept spec, not proof of compiled UI. Keep Chinese sharp and all paths, states, legends, and action labels accurate.

settingsPrompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create the FINAL PhotosYNC SETTINGS design board, consolidating accepted references. Reference1 gives the accepted compact TWO-LINE directory row with leading truncation. Reference2 gives accepted first-configuration grouping. Native macOS600-logical-point-wide settings windows, maximum680pt content height, consistent scale, side-by-side natural heights. Canvas2048x1408. Light mode on BOTH windows to compare structures. Board title "PhotosYNC · 设置定稿", subtitle "目录两行展示 · 来源独立滚动 · 常用选项始终可达". Natural native traffic-light TITLEBARS are allowed on these settings windows. Use crisp Chinese PingFang system typography, grey system surfaces, subtle separators/shadows, blue existing buttons, small outline folder symbols. No sidebar, no tabs, no metric dashboard, no analysis/progress bar in settings.
LEFT scene caption"首次配置":
native titlebar"PhotosYNC 设置". Main status"未配置来源". Boundary caption"只读取来源文件，向“照片”新增内容。停用来源会保留同步记录。"
First section"照片访问": explanation"需要“照片”的完整读写权限，才能核对重复并新增照片。请主动授权后开始同步。" and blue existing button"授权访问照片". Do NOT repeat this notice at bottom.
Second section"来源" with existing neutral bordered"添加来源目录…" aligned right. Modest empty state small folder outline and"尚未添加来源目录", no dropzone/illustration.
Third section"同步选项": native unchecked checkboxes"来源首次失败和恢复时通知" and"登录时启动" in separate rows. Caption"启动后扫描，每 30 分钟自动扫描；来源不可用时自动等待恢复。".
Stable bottom section"诊断" with button"在 Finder 中打开日志目录", tiny footer"PhotosYNC 0.2.0 beta". No other actions.
RIGHT scene caption"多个来源与异常":
same titlebar, main status"等待恢复" with small clock; same boundary caption. No Photos permission region because this scene is authorized.
Header"来源" left and existing blue"添加来源目录…" right. ONE bounded scroll list about280pt high with visible native scrollbar, showing6 rows. EACH ROW EXACTLY TWO TEXT LINES. Line1 is one continuous INLINE path: grey caption ancestor"…/家庭影像与旅行归档/2026/" followed by DARK primary body-weight final basename"年度照片与视频原片" on the SAME BASELINE. Never use a separate basename above path. Beginning ellipsis only; no middle or trailing truncation; preserve whole basename when it fits. Exact same format for2025,2024,2023,2022,2021. Reserve width for right-aligned buttons and don't let text overlap buttons.
Line2 is status. First"来源目录不可用，正在等待恢复。" with small amber warning; second"已启用"; third"已停用 · 记录保留"; remaining rows healthy/disabled. Small outline folder icon on left spanning both text lines. Compact row height, thin separators.
Enabled rows right native controls"停用","移除". Disabled rows controls"启用","移除", both ENABLED dark text (do not fade the Enable button). Underlying action/confirmation unchanged.
Show ONE standard native full-path tooltip on hovering the first row, floating above that row; text"/Volumes/家庭影像与旅行归档/2026/年度照片与视频原片". Tooltip is an OVERLAY, not a third row; make sure it doesn't cover add button or section header unnecessarily.
Under bounded source list, always-visible section"同步选项": same two checkboxes and same caption. Under that stable footer"诊断" and"在 Finder 中打开日志目录", version"PhotosYNC 0.2.0 beta". No whole-window long source scroll that hides these options.
Keep both windows600pt widths and <=680pt natural content heights. No new backend settings, no configurable scan interval, no retry/restart/cleanup, no analysis page, no threshold controls. Full-path hover + two-line rows and stable options are critical. No product-code modifications implied. Current date anchor2026-10-13Asia/Shanghai if dates appear. Everything should look like feasible native SwiftUI/AppKit, not web mockup.
